follow-up time: Almost 5 years after the operation (median 57 months, range 8-189)
cohort: 186 women with neuropathic groin pain due to iliohypogastric and/or ilioinguinal nerve entrapment following a Pfannenstiel incision
finding: A step-up approach of tender point infiltration followed by surgical neurectomy was an effective treatment for chronic post-Pfannenstiel pain syndrome due to nerve entrapment.
